underlying_goal: Migrate market review dashboard from Wind API to iChoice, customize indicators (remove VIX, add convertible bond metrics), and generate/share screenshot reports
friction_detail: Email sending required many failed attempts across multiple methods; iChoice account lacked permissions for convertible bond valuation fields, blocking a key user request.
brief_summary: User wanted to update market dashboard data source, customize indicators, and share screenshots; basic migration and VIX removal succeeded but convertible bond valuation data was blocked by API permissions, and email sending required extensive trial and error.
